purpose: Show exact phone-size compositions before motion and full rendering consume production time.
hard_gates: Frames must bind exact assets, safe zones, protected faces, captions and brand identities.
soft_gates: Hierarchy, legibility, rhythm and emotional tone should survive a phone-size preview.

failure.fallback: Revise the visual plan or exact asset layout before introducing timing or motion.

regression_cases: Wordmarks remain legible and collision-free at a 375 pixel preview width.
No approved frame truncates visible editorial text.
